activation_amendment.stage: before evaluator introduction and before any target execution
activation_amendment.reason: Shell git push has no authenticated write path; connected GitHub exposes branch creation but no tag creation or workflow dispatch. Preserve one deliberate finalized-code activation using its supported branch-create event.
activation_amendment.policy: Create this branch once from the final runner code SHA. Workflow gates exact branch, create event, first attempt. No pull_request/push triggers. Later documentation or sealing commits cannot execute target. Forward rerun requires documented packet exception; never mutate old evidence.
